key_interpretations: SBI Group is pursuing multiple rails: XRP/RLUSD via Ripple-linked businesses and USDC/JPYSC via Circle Arc.
Circle Arc is a serious stablecoin-native and agentic-payment competitor, but Circle USDC is also natively available on XRPL; competition and complementarity coexist.
The x402 protocol is open and vendor-neutral under Linux Foundation governance; Coinbase contributed it, while Circle, Ripple and t54 Labs are members.
XRPL x402 payment events demonstrate technical utility, but current reported USD settlement value is small and does not prove incremental XRP purchases.
Exchange wallet movements and ETF holdings must not be converted directly into customer withdrawals, executable float or actual cash inflows.
